title: Is anyone making money scalping XAUUSD with an AI bot?
author: SignificantPeak7614
selftext:
I'm a software engineer exploring the idea of building an AI/ML bot to scalp gold (XAUUSD) on the M1 timeframe.

I'm curious whether anyone here has built or used one successfully.

\* Are you training your own models or using existing ones?

\* Is it actually profitable after spreads and slippage?

\* What win rate and risk-to-reward ratio do you achieve?

I'd appreciate honest experiences, including failures. Is this worth pursuing, or is it mostly a waste of time?
